# Writing a blog entry (fixture)

A small budget, so the planted entry can be short enough to read at a glance. The gate
reads these two numbers rather than carrying its own copy, and this file is what it
reads in the fixture tree.

| Part | Words |
|---|---|
| prose — everything after the front matter, code, alt text and URLs not counted | 40 |
| description — the front matter line the index shows | 12 |
